notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on what moved. The 2008 chapter report says the cab; Kresek's account (NHLR) says the whole cab and catwalk came off a 40-ft tower with the legs reset on piers; the lookout sites register says the tower. The register's chronology puts the 1983 cab on a 42-ft tower, so the 40 vs 42 ft conflict is unresolved. The record's relocated event has no year; sources give 2008. The move reason also differs: a Homeland Security facility (NHLR crane caption) vs electronics interests (2008 report). Current condition is not established. The only condition note on the register is an undated visit report by Rod Fosback, written after the 2004 visit; it says the structure is still very sound but describes vandalism. It does not say where the structure was, so the story does not place it at the fairgrounds. Visitor access was not found, so no access facts are given. Two search summaries claimed a 1959 original tower and other details that are not on any page read; not used. Mountain site story is us-wa-stranger-mountain.
